method_notes: RBKC admission arrangements for community primary schools 2026-27, criterion 5: 'Children living nearest to the school calculated as a straight line... to the main entrance of the school building used by pupils. For any school that has more than one entrance... the entrance of the main school reception will be used as the measuring point', using the Council's computerised measuring system. Accessibility by car or public transport is disregarded. Applicants sharing an address point, or at exactly the same distance, are separated by random allocation. Fox Primary: places inside a designated priority area are allocated by random allocation, then by straight-line distance for applicants outside it. Exceptions from the brochure summaries: Christ Church CofE uses the shortest walking route; Holy Trinity CofE measures to a midpoint between its Cadogan Gardens and Sedding Street sites; Ark Brunel measures to the centre of the school grounds; Kensington Primary Academy to its main gate on Kensington High Street; St Francis of Assisi and St Mary's Catholic from the front door of the home. Brochure figures are 'How places were offered' (last offer distance, in miles).

gaps: Westminster and RBKC brochures share a format but are separate; no school appears in both. Missing: Servite 2025 (brochure says 'TBC'). St Joseph's 2025 also says 'TBC' but gives a Category 6 distance, which is recorded. For mixed foundation/open VA schools (Christ Church, Holy Trinity, St Mary Abbots, St Barnabas & St Philip's) the value recorded is the open/community-place distance; the foundation distances are in criterion_note. Holy Trinity 2024 prints foundation 0.265 miles and open 1.037 miles (recorded as printed). Kensington Primary Academy 2026 says 'All were offered (up to 2.029 of a mile)', so it is recorded as all_offered. St Clement & St James is printed as 'All on-time applicants were submitted' (taken as all offered). Fox Primary has no distance cut-off (priority-area random allocation). Our Lady of Victories 2024 ended on random allocation. St Cuthbert with St Matthias CofE Primary (SW5) appears in the 2026 and 2025 brochures (all offered in 2025 and 2024) but not in the 2027 brochure, so it is presumed closed/merged and left out; I did not verify this. Most VA measuring points are unstated and assumed to be straight line. Postcodes come from the brochure school pages, not checked against GIAS. Holy Trinity uses the Sedding Street postcode.
